parsed.name: BioShake 加热振荡器
parsed.description: 台式加热振荡器，用于对微孔板或样品板进行可控振荡并同时进行温度控制。设备带有可归位的移动平台和（可选）板锁定机构，能设定振荡速度、加速度/减速度，并报告当前温度以用于温控实验。常用于混匀、孵育和温度依赖的样品处理步骤。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop heater-shaker for microplates or sample plates that combines controllable orbital or linear shaking with temperature control. The device features a homing-capable moving platform, optional plate locking to secure plates, adjustable shake speed and accel/decel, and a temperature sensor for closed-loop heating. Used for mixing, incubation, and temperature-dependent sample processing.
